command_line:
{
set +e
printf '%s\n' '--- dev tree ---'
find /software/atac-seq-pipeline -maxdepth 5 -printf '%M %s %p\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- root bins / jars ---'
find / -maxdepth 3 \( -iname '*cromwell*' -o -iname '*caper*' -o -iname '*.jar' -o -iname 'java' -o -iname 'womtool*' \) 2>/dev/null | sort | head -300
printf '%s\n' '--- java ---'
java -version 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '--- python scripts help relevant ---'
python /software/atac-seq-pipeline/src/encode_task_reproducibility.py --help 2>&1 | head -80
python /software/atac-seq-pipeline/src/encode_task_qc_report.py --help 2>&1 | head -80
printf '%s\n' '--- git status ---'
cd /software/atac-seq-pipeline 2>/dev/null; git status 2>&1 | head -30; git describe --tags 2>&1; git log -1 --oneline 2>&1
} > probe.txt 2>&1
